steps: Badge: Healthy, Quality dropped (yellow), poor (red), Restricted
Yellow: campaigns auto-paused; red: no new templates; recover by sending fewer, wanted messages
edgeCases: Number quality drops to YELLOW/RED or WhatsApp restricts the account: campaigns auto-pause, no new templates until recovered; campaigns never restart by themselves
Number flagged/banned/restricted by WhatsApp: Numbers shows a badge + explanation; Meta (not Ebda) decides the appeal
Campaigns never restart automatically; resume manually
Older health signals retried later are dropped (ordered by Meta time)
gaps: No guided recovery checklist; no appeal flow (Meta-side)
